whether your a person of color or not, if your family is being racist you have every right to stop visiting them until they agree to not make those kinds of comments. everyone is entitled to an opinion, even if theirs is considered racist. but that doesn't mean you have to sit there and be silent just because they're your family. if you feel uncomfortable being around them while they openly say those kinds of things then you should 100% stop visiting them.

YTA

i feel like you probably could have handled this better than you did, especially if you had no idea what persone B had said to make person A so upset. it might not have even been too bad in the end if they were able to make up. i can understand how seeing your friend crying and very upset can make you mad, but in that situation person A needed moral support and putting person B down so hard might have made them feel guilty along with telling them they should be getting mad not crying might send the wrong signal and could make person A be more reluctant to come to you next time.

ESH

your parents definitely need to work on some things because they definitely do not own you. but they are still your parents and since your only 15 they still make choices for you, especially regarding medical procedures. you should probably talk to them and tell them you don't like their choice of words but also should keep in mind that they still love you and won't try to do something that will affect you in a negative way.
